seo.title: Involve | Cultural and Charitable Society, Vatakara, Kerala
seo.description: Involve Cultural and Charitable Society is a forum of enthusiastic and like-minded people who have joined together with a vision to create a platform for supporting various social, cultural and educational activities.

hero.title: INVOLVE
hero.subtitle: Cultural and Charitable Society
hero.text: A forum of like-minded people supporting social, cultural and educational activities.

green.title: Green Project
green.text: Involve Green is an eco endeavour by Involve to promote nature friendly living. It is a green initiative that encourages the society to embrace nature by promoting the origination and maintenance of vegetations such as Trees, Green Spaces, Tiny Forests, Big Forests and Agricultural Farms.

forest.title: A forest for tomorrow
forest.text: A forest for tomorrow, for the earth and for the birds.

contact.title: In touch with Involve
contact.intro: For enquiries, volunteering or collaboration, write to us or call the office.
